notablePrerequisites:
Seeker of Skybreak and Sanctum Weaver do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three enchantments.
description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Sanctum Weaver.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.
